notes.title: Update 0.6.5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, first sorry for the time it took to update the game, but the last two/three months have been really hard for me and as you know I am solo developing this game, so it took this long.

I had many more features planned for this update, but sadly I wasn't able to implement all of them, so this is why I am releasing this update as 0.6.5, because it is half the way I had planned for 0.7 update. I decided in order for you guys not to wait longer and since there are some bug fixes in this update to split the update into two parts.

So here's the list of what you can expect in this update:


- Reworked the FPS system, now guns have animations like reload, firing etc

- Reworked Bow

- You can now move items directly to storage chest with one click, by clicking with the right mouse button when Storage is opened (Works with Log Cart also)

- When building structures like floors and fences the terrain will adjust to the built structure 

- Improved the way enemy camps spawn, now the terrain will fit the camps

- Changed enemies de-spawn system, now they will only disappear if you leave the area, this way you have time to loot the dead enemies

- Arrows will now stay on the ground when enemy/animal disappears if not looted

- Now you can repair guns in the Workbench

- Improved Shooter AI now they will find cover and be able to vault some platforms

- Fixed enemy camps campfire not working

- Fixed motocross preview turning into campfire preview

- Fixed Sniper rifle scope not working

- Added Auto Unstuck if you are stuck underground when entering the game

- Fixed a bug that caused Game Time to be stuck at Day 1 this would prevent some game features to work because the game time was stuck


Please if you find any bug or have any suggestion, feel free to report it on the forums!

I hope you enjoy! 
Thank you all!

notes.title: First Person View improvements / Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Small but very important update, in this update you can expect more improvements to First Person Mode and Inventory/Craft system

- Optimized performance of First Person Mode, now it will give you way more frames per second

- Added stabilizer to reduce head bobbing in the First Person Mode

- Fixed not being able to craft an item even if it could stack with other (example: you have your inventory full, and you want to craft a rope from fibrous leaves, if you have another rope it will now craft and stack with the existing one)

- Fixed not being able to craft an item even if it could occupy the needed items in the inventory slot (example: you have full inventory, but in it, you have three rocks, and you want to craft a sharpened stone, now the system will predict if the final item could occupy the three rocks inventory slot)

- Fixed Fridge turning into a Chest after reloading game

Here's a video comparing the improments on FPS:
[previewyoutube=Q9WbaNEFAlY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all!

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here's a list of what you can expect in this Update 0.6:


- Reworked the Stamina System, now the stamina is dependent on Energy that can be recovered when sleeping or by eating/drinking some food like Energy Snack/Energy Drink
the more energy you have the faster the stamina recovers

- Now you can Save the game anywhere from Options as long as enemies are not around

- Fixed Aiming when playing in FPS Mode, some times the gun moved outside the aim zone

- Fixed game being locked to 60 Fps

- Fixed Enemy camps stop spawning

- Improved Light and Shadows at night time

- Improved build items placement, now they will not overlap each other

- Added a new item Electronic Part

- Added a new placeable Solar Panel that can store energy and recharge vehicle batteries

- Added a new placeable Fuse Box that can distribute energy gathered by solar panels and also will indicate the energy you have IN/OUT

- Added a new placeable Fridge where you can store food and make them last way longer (it needs eletricity from a Fuse Box)

- Added a new placeable Ceiling Light that you can place on the roof of your base, it will turn on when is night time if you have a Fuse Box and the needed energy

- Added Military Drone, this drones roam around the island to check on how Inmates are behaving, if you destroy a drone it will give you Electronic Parts

- Added Aluminium Boulders when destroyed will give Aluminium Ore that can be melted into Aluminium Ingot in the Furnace

- Added Copper Boulders when destroyed will give Copper Ore that can be melted into Copper Ingot in the Furnace

- Added Motocross Vehicle, it need some parts to be able to drive such as Motocross Engine, Vehicle Battery, Tires and Fuel

- Added Motocross Engine (Can be picked at loots)

- Added Vehicle Battery (can be crafted on the Workbench)

- Added Tires (Can be picked at loots)

- Added Gas Can item (Can be picked at loots) later there will be away to produce Fuel

- Added Energy Bar and Energy Drink, they recover Player energy when consumed

Video Preview of some new features:
[previewyoutube=y2GA02brv68;full][/previewyoutube]

Some features like the bike interactions will be improved over the next week

Please if you find any bug or have any suggestion, feel free to report it on the forums!

I hope you enjoy! 
Thank you all!

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, First I want to say sorry for the bugs you have encountered, and I understand that they can be really frustrating, but know that, I will always try to fix them as fast as possible. 

This update is focused on refactoring some systems like Terrain rendering, Vegetation, and also Inventory improvements and many others.

- Improved the way the Terrain is loaded and rendered, it will load way faster

- Improved vegetation system and fixed a bug causing vegetation to be infinity respawned

- Improved Inventory System:
         - Fixed a Bug that caused items to dissapear from inventory
         - Fixed not being able to craft a physical structure like campfire, when inventory is full
         - Fixed not being able to loot items that could stack when inventory is full

- Fixed a bug with water still, now it will remove the last selected container when exiting the menu

- Fixed Basic Shelter being randomly destroyed after day 3

- Fixed not being able to save if a dead Animal would be in the surrounding area

- Fixed a bug that allowed to interact with structures such as Chests while having a crafting preview active

- Improved melee attacking detection when looking down, things like breaking a coconut shall be easier

- Increased drop rates and items quantity in random drops when roaming the map

- Added Steel Hammer, Axe, Pickaxe they have more durability and will destroy Tree's and Rock Boulders faster (they can be crafted on the Anvil)

I am reworking the Saving/Sleep system (you will be able to save anywhere). also the way stamina works will change in the next update

Please report any bug or suggestion in the forums.

Stay tuned!

Thank you all for your patience!

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is an update that brings new content to the game like rivers, swamps, crocodiles, leopards but also many fixes and improvements to the core system.

- Added Rivers and Swamps to the map

- Added Crocodile AI, they spawn in the swamps and drop Crocodile Skin, it can be used to double the inventory space

- Added Leopard AI, this is a super aggressive animal, it dies fast but kills fast, he will drop Feline Claw that will be used later in the next update to craft a Machete

- Improved Gun Reload mechanic, now the gun only uses the bullets it needs, and keeps the rest on the magazine

- Changed Fence building logic, now it will work like building a base, with pre setup points, so the fences stay align with each other, also you can craft Gate, and it will be aligned.

- You can now craft a Log Cart, it can pick up and store any logs in the surrounded area, you can also "Drive" it (this will be getting improvements over the week like animations, sounds, etc), it is really useful when building the base

- Added Improved Bag, it will double your inventory space and can be crafted in the Workbench

- Added fish's to the rivers, you can catch them with a Spear (they are now removed from the Ocean and will only spawn in the rivers) 

- Added the ability to Repair Base parts and Fences by hitting them with a Hammer

- Increased Fences/Bases parts health

- Fixed items randomly losing Durability,

- Fixed Items such as Meat, Vegetables and all the others not saving inside Campfire, Furnace, Plant bed, etc

- Medicine items such as Pills, bandages, etc can now be placed in the hot bar and be used with a hotkey

- Added Invert mouse options

- Fixed Bone armor/helmet not protecting from gunfire

-Fixed upgraded campfire not working properly

Please update your game and report any bug you might find or if you have suggestions or features you would like to have in the game please post them in the forums.

Thank you all for your patience!

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the first update after Early Access release, it's mostly focused on fixing some bugs reported by the Players and an attempt to balance the game

- Fixed some problems related with quick access bar that would bug the weapon slot
- Fixed a bug that not allowed equipping weapons if the inventory was full
- Fixed a bug preventing items from stack when picked up if the inventory was full
- Fixed craft interaction icons disappearing if to close to them
- Fixed Airdrops falling into the ocean
- Increased day time length
- Increased the amount of nutrients you get when eating some food like corn, potatoes etc
- Increased spawn rate of food items like Corn, Potatoes, Mushrooms etc
- Fixed the text displayed by the Glock Magazine item in the workbench
- Now enemies only attack your base after day 5 (they still spawn in the world near zones of interest like Special Loots)
- Added Ak47 Magazine, Shotgun Shell, Sniper Magazine to the workbench
- Fixed a bug that allowed you to interact with Shelter from very far
- Fixed a bug preventing Water Still and Plant Bed getting water level to full when raining

The next update will bring some changes to the island, two new animals will be added (Crocodile (swamp zone) and a Leopard). A river will be added and some logic to the water system will be changed, so you will be able to collect water from rivers and purify the water in the campfire. Also, new melee items that you will be able to craft with iron/steel will be added, such as Steel Axe, Hammer and Pickaxe.

Please update your game and report any bug you might find or if you have suggestions post them in the forums.

Thank you all!
